primary_contract: C#/.NET and Power Platform service-boundary architecture over shared calculator contracts
support_scope: Architecture and governance documentation for a C#/.NET service boundary and Power Platform orchestration surface. The track documents contract consumption, logging/privacy rules, fixture alignment, and the rule that Power Platform must not contain calculator formula logic. It does not provide an executable C# engine, signed NuGet package, or tenant-validated Power Platform runtime.

gap_register.gap: No executable C# calculation engine is completed by this track.
gap_register.rationale: Later Rust-core governance makes C# a downstream adapter/service boundary rather than the formula owner.

gap_register.gap: No NuGet/package publication evidence is claimed here.
gap_register.rationale: Package publication is owned by the .NET/NuGet registry submission track and support-status evidence.

gap_register.gap: No live Power Platform tenant/runtime validation is claimed here.
gap_register.rationale: Power Platform implementation and live tenant proof are owned by the Power Platform binding and runtime evidence tracks.

description: C#/.NET service-boundary architecture and Power Platform orchestration rules.
